articles.headline: Edesa Biotech Announces Agreement with KYORIN Pharmaceutical to Develop and Commercialize Paridiprubart in Japan
articles.summary: Edesa announces an exclusive Japanese paridiprubart license: $12 million upfront, up to approximately $134 million in conditional milestones and tiered royalties. Potential milestones are not received revenue; the drug remains investigational.
